2085. Exploring Pre and Post Increment Operators

Problem Statement
Read an integer and print the results of using it with both post-increment and pre-increment operators in expressions.
Description
Read an integer x. Compute a = post-increment of x. Compute b = pre-increment of x. Print a, b, and the final value of x, each on its own line.
output_spec: Print a, then b, then the final value of x, each on its own line.
